result.summary: Several layout and content clipping issues are visible: truncated restaurant names, a cut-off category pill, and a partially obscured promo card at the bottom. These hurt scannability and make the feed feel unfinished.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card title is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis or full name visible.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size on long names, or use ellipsis with a full name on the detail screen so names are not cut off mid-word.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promo card is heavily cropped by the bottom navigation, hiding most of the image and any title/metadata.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the tab bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view, or reduce card height.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped on the right—only a sliver of the next pill is visible with no clear affordance that the list scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/peek of the next chip or a subtle scroll indicator so users know more categories are available.

issues.description: Delivery fee on Green Bowl Poké is shown as '€0.90 delivery' while the popular card uses '€0 delivery'—inconsistent unit/label formatting across sections.
issues.suggestion: Standardize delivery fee labels (e.g. always '€X.XX delivery' or 'Free delivery') for visual consistency.

issues.description: Heart/favorite icons sit on dark photo areas with limited contrast, especially on the ramen card.
issues.suggestion: Add a light circular backdrop or stronger stroke/shadow so the icon remains visible on any image.
